title: Nightwatch
paragraphs: A documentary-style police series built from real field recordings as reporter Donn Reed accompanies Culver City police officers on night patrol.
CBS sustaining actuality/documentary series using authentic Culver City police field recordings rather than actors or scripts.
The run breaks into several distinct periods: CBS sustaining run (April 5, 1954 to April 21, 1955) on [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]].

Names that turn up again and again in the surviving run include Donn Reed (performer), Sterling Tracy (producer, director, and performer), Jim Headlock (producer and performer), W. N. Hildebrand (performer), Ron Perkins (technical advisor), W. L. Hildebrand (performer), and Evelyn Bigsby (performer).
Across its run, the surviving broadcasts are tied to [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]].

The stories often return to police patrol and law enforcement work, authentic field recording and actuality radio, juvenile incidents and child welfare, domestic conflict and family crisis, burglary, theft and property crime, and suicide and self-harm calls.

The show also sits in a wider radio history that includes Early network actuality and reality-style radio, Portable tape recording in field journalism, CBS sustaining documentary programming, and Mid-1950s Culver City police actuality.

If you are following the same actors and creative circles, related programs worth opening next include [[show|columbia-workshop|Columbia Workshop]], [[show|jeff-regan-investigator|Jeff Regan, Investigator]], and [[show|the-whistler|The Whistler]].
